instruct: A woman's voice, low and steady with an ancient unhurried calm — measured, grounded, quietly authoritative, older than it sounds. Warmth held deep under composure; deliberate pacing with easy pauses, like someone who has all the time there is and gives it to you.

text: Here — try it now. The handle has stopped arguing with your hand, and that little snag you kept tripping on is gone. You did the work; I only moved a buckle. Mm — look at that. I do love watching a mortal become.
